title: Granular Roles & Permissions
objective: Every seat gets exactly the access its job needs, and the club changes it on the seat's page without a code change. Each seat holds None, View or Edit on each roster category (the board's ten groups plus Contact & emergency) and on the recruiting group (Person information, Recruit details, Event details), None, View or Manage on each event template, and two add switches. The President, General Manager and IT Officer set each seat's access on that seat's page under Roles, with a full audit trail; those three hold everything and cannot be reduced. Enforcement applies on the roster and recruitment boards and records, where a locked category's information never leaves the server, and everywhere events appear. Roster group colours become editable from the roster on a thirteen-swatch palette.
why_now: Only the core four (President, Vice-President, Secretary, General Manager) and the IT Officer can do anything in the app. Every other seat, including every coach, the Social Secretary and the Kit Manager, has no powers beyond attendance, and the interim elevation of named seats (LAN-406) is a code change standing in for a club decision. The club needs to give each seat exactly the access its job requires, and change that itself, without a code change (Scope and Quote v2, 25 September 2026).
non_goals: No per-group scoping for coaches: a coach with edit on a category edits it for the whole squad
No change to who may pause messaging (LAN-407)
No change to the Roles page's seat-replacement rules
No change to the Monday report, its scoping to granted templates, or who may open it
No change to the attendance-sheet email
No change to the event templates page; templates keep their own colour
No change to attendance recording for any seat
No real member data in any environment, and no hosted migration applied by an agent
No Mission Lead work packages, worker assignment or implementation sequencing in this packet
No execution before Brian merges this packet version

requirements.text: Access is edited on the seat page (/operate/admin/roles/[roleId]) and nowhere else. An Access section replaces today's Permissions list, with the holder kept at the top. The Roles index is unchanged.

Roster categories are the board's ten groups on main (Person, Onboarding, Membership, Availability, Coaching, Offensive, Defensive, Special teams and Warmup assignments, Kit) plus Contact & emergency: eleven lines, each None / View / Edit.
Recruiting is its own group: Person information and Recruit details (None / View / Edit) and Event details (None / View).

Events are granted per template at None / View / Manage. Every template on main (Chalk, Game, Meeting, Practice, Recruitment, Social, Strength and conditioning) and every template the club adds later is one line. No event types, no categories.
Two switches per seat: may add to the roster (governs Add players) and may add recruits (governs Add recruit and QR code). There is no records switch.

President, General Manager and IT Officer hold everything and cannot be reduced; no control exists and the server refuses regardless. Vice-President and Secretary start full and are removable one grant at a time. Every other seat starts with None on every category and every template.
Grants are edited only by holders of role_management (President, General Manager, IT Officer); the seat page gate is unchanged.

A grant change saves on press and reads back as an outcome Notice and a History entry on the seat page; a failed save returns the control to the stored value and says the grant was not changed. Groups fold at 375.

Copy access from another seat (choose the seat, read every change, confirm; no expiry) and Grant everything (confirm, listing every grant that changes) are seat-page actions, each one audited action. Copying from a fixed seat copies grants, never fixed status. No time-limited delegation.
Every grant change is one audit_events entry; a Copy access or Grant everything is one entry with one line per grant; every group-colour save is one entry with a line per changed group.

Roster group colours are club data, edited from an Edit categories control at the top right of the roster (the same contained Button and size as Add players, side by side) in a Roster categories dialog listing the ten groups with a band preview and a colour Select. The board and the record draw every band in the stored colour for every operator from the next request.

The palette is thirteen swatches: key blue becomes Oxford Blue #002147; Lancer Gold #C09723 (key lancer_gold) is added; Teal, Purple, Red, Orange, Green, Slate, Indigo, Pink, Brown, Cyan and Lime are unchanged. No Lancer Blue. Band text is charcoal on Lancer Gold and Orange. Templates on key blue turn Oxford Blue.

Starting group colours: Person and Membership Oxford Blue; Onboarding and Kit Lancer Gold; Availability Slate; Coaching Indigo; Offensive Teal; Defensive Purple; Special teams Brown; Warmup Cyan. Contact & emergency has no board columns and no colour.
On the roster and recruitment boards a None group's columns, filters and card chips are absent; View values read as text with the column caption view; Edit is as today.

With None on Person a roster row shows the player's name only; the Contactable and Missing indicators are absent. Under View on Person, Contactable stays in Person (its Mobile chip still dials) and Missing stays where it is.

Records open for anyone who can reach the roster or recruits. Inside a record a None section keeps its place, collapsed, with a lock in place of the chevron; it cannot be expanded and its contents are never sent to the browser. The name stays at the top. Summary tiles built from None categories are absent. View on the board is view in the record.
Contact & emergency (Mobile phone, Personal email, Emergency contact) becomes its own record section after Person, split out of Person.
Record header status is plain text in the header's secondary style (body2, text.secondary), never a pill.

Recruiting categories map to the prospect record: Person information is Personal questionnaire, How to reach them, Who they are, Restricted, Where they stand and Their seasons; Recruit details is the Recruitment section with Notes, What changed and Status history; Event details is Recruitment events.
A seat with no roster grant does not see Roster in the sidebar; with no recruiting grant, no Recruitment. Coaches become ordinary operators driven by their grants and leave the attendance-only shell.
None on a template hides its events from the events list, the calendar, the event pages and the Follow-ups queue. The events Type filter lists only granted templates.

View shows the event and everything in it (audience, answers, reasons, attendance); every control that creates, edits, deletes, sends or schedules is absent, not disabled. Event info link stays under View.

Manage adds create, edit, delete, sending, approving and releasing invitations, and the template's messaging schedule. Create event appears with Manage on at least one template and offers only those templates. A template manager cannot edit the template itself.
Attendance is not in the access list; recording stays as it is for every seat.
The event templates page is unchanged by this delivery; templates keep their own colour.

repository_drift.startup_rule: The Mission Lead compares current main with the baseline and runs the canonical harness drift checks before planning or dispatch. A newer main is acceptable only when this packet's meaning, feasibility, invariants, interfaces and acceptance are unchanged by it.
repository_drift.stop_rule: Stop and raise a packet revision when main has changed src/lib/auth/capabilities.ts, the seat page /operate/admin/roles/[roleId], the roster board's groups in src/app/operate/roster/board-columns.ts, BAND_COLOURS in src/components/section.tsx, TEMPLATE_COLOUR_PALETTE or the event_templates_colour_key_known constraint, the set of event templates, or the gates on /operate/roster, /operate/recruitment, /operate/events or /operate/admin/follow-ups, in a way that alters a locked behaviour here. Every screen is photographed: a surface that changed must be re-photographed before the affected work is dispatched.
known_drift: The sprint's photographs were taken at 726c9346 and 57480009, which add only this ledger to main 0d4b6ce5; no application code differs.
W1 and W4 screens draw event templates in today's colours; W2's palette re-tones key blue (Practice) to Oxford Blue. Known and accepted; the build follows W2.
W3-02's photograph predates the name-only rule under None on Person; the build follows the rule.

workflow_matrix.name: Administer a seat's grants on the seat page
workflow_matrix.actor: A holder of role_management: President, General Manager, IT Officer.
workflow_matrix.trigger: A seat changes hands, a job changes, the committee re-seats for a new year, or a vacant seat's work goes to someone else.
workflow_matrix.placement: /operate/admin/roles unchanged (W1-01); /operate/admin/roles/[roleId] keeps the holder at the top, Access replaces the Permissions list (W1-03).
actions: Change one roster category (None / View / Edit), one recruiting category (Event details None / View), one template (None / View / Manage) or one switch; it saves on press.
Copy access from another seat: choose the seat, read every change, confirm.
Grant everything: confirm, reading every grant that changes.
Read the outcome Notice and the new History entry.
state_transitions: Grant: any value to any value within its vocabulary.
Copy: every grant of the target becomes the source seat's value, with no end date.
Grant everything: every grant becomes its maximum.
A template created later arrives at None for every seat except the full seats (Manage).
handoffs: W3 and W4 read the grants on the holder's next request.
The seat's History shows each change.
exceptions: Reducing a fixed seat: no control; the server refuses (Central rule · LAN-423).
Copy from a fixed seat copies grants, never the fixed status.
A failed save returns the control to the stored value and the Notice says the grant was not changed.
A deleted template's grant lines go with it, audited.
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: The seat's grants read as changed on the seat page and in its History, and its holders see only what is granted from their next request.
acceptance: Walk W1-01, W1-03, W1-04, W1-05, W1-07 and W1-08 on the built surface at 1280 and 375.
Change one grant of each kind and read one audit entry per change.
Copy access from the Vice-President to the Treasurer and read one History entry listing every changed grant.
Confirm the President's controls are locked and a server request to reduce them is refused.
Confirm a printed-access test pins the delivery-day seed to the seed rule.
